# MZ | Research. Software. Knowledge.

## About MZ
MZ is a technology engineering firm based in Cairo, Egypt. We build proprietary systems and transfer the exact knowledge our clients need to run them.
- **Location:** Cairo, Egypt
- **Email:** hello@mzfortech.com

## Core Philosophy
Research, Software, Knowledge. In that order.

## Products

### Occhio (OK-yoo)
An OCR (Optical Character Recognition) system that reads Arabic the way Arabic should be read.
Most document processing tools were built for Latin scripts and extended to Arabic later. Occhio starts where the region starts: Arabic, French, and English as equal priorities, designed for the institutional documents governments, universities, and enterprises in MENA actually handle. (Currently in development).
